_comment: Canonical values for checks/uniform.mjs. A number is px (within the gate's --tolerance), a string is compared exactly,
null means the majority of the run at each viewport and mode (the report prints the distribution: pick a value and write it here).
A value can be split by {"light", "dark"}, {"desktop", "phone"} or "desktop-light" and so on. * stands for one dotted segment.
Values with a source: lab/new-theme/astryx-ref/spec.json (components), as measured on the approved M2 overview by scripts/measure.mjs.

table.row.button._source: spec Table body row with sm Button

table.kv.row.text._source: M2 overview System card (spec has no key/value table)

table.progress.td._source: M2 overview Memory and Storage cards

card._source: spec Card (default); gap is the overview grid gap

font.body.fontFamily: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Noto Sans TC Variable, PingFang TC, Microsoft JhengHei, Arial, sans-serif

font.code.fontFamily: ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, monospace
